The '''Orlan household''' was the residence of the family of [[Karin Orlan]] on<ref name="Journal4">{{JournalCite|4|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|63|Quian}}</ref> [[Quian]]. At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Empire carried out a raid at the household.<ref name="Journal4" />
